name: KM REX/NGPL Joint Project Phase 2
monitor_reason: concrete step and length: no source shows the line was ever built or reached a concrete step; EIA row looks like an artifact
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 628, lists 240 mi, 42 in, 1000 MMcf/d, Iowa and Illinois, Kinder Morgan Energy Partners, completed November 2009, FERC docket 'na'. Row 629 (KM REX/NGPL Phase 1, WY, KS, IA, 175 mi) has the same pattern. The only independent source found is a Natural Gas Intelligence report of January 16, 2008. It says Rockies Express and Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America were reviving a long-shelved idea for a direct line from the Meeker and Opal hubs to Chicago. The project was at an early stage with no design, no cost estimate and no open season, and a target in-service date of October 2011. That article does not name Iowa or Illinois, 240 miles or 42 inches. It is not the P0246 Rockies Express main line, which does not cross Iowa. Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America later built a different, smaller Chicago Market Expansion (2014 open season, from the Rockies Express connection in Moultrie County, Illinois). We found no evidence the Iowa to Illinois line was built or got a FERC filing, so the EIA completed status is probably an EIA artifact. Not a match to an existing row. No length or capacity can be cited from a validated source, so this fails the length rule and the concrete-step test. Monitor only.
